These higher subscription bills are arriving just as the flood of new TV programming has started to ease. [...] Looked at another way, the old cable bill is not far off. Leichtman Research Group said the average pay-TV bill was $103.10 in 2016, and Fortune noted that Consumer Price Index adjustments would put that at about $143 in July 2026.
